limitation: Development single-seed factorial trial. Two-qubit cells also change encoding, parameter count and readout; dimensionality alone is not causally isolated. Fixed eight-epoch budget is diagnostic only, not a final performance threshold or elimination rule. Speed does not break performance ties or select a winner.

final_epoch_contrasts.interpretation: Metric differences; negative indicates lower error for the positive-sign cell. Best-epoch contrasts may compare different epochs.
